create_SonarTextTransformerEncoderModel: create a SonarTextTransformerEncoderModel with a TransformerFrontend, TransformerEncoder, and pooling strategy
run_SonarTextTransformerEncoderModel_for: run the forward pass of SonarTextTransformerEncoderModel to encode sequences and produce sentence embeddings
build_pooling_static_pooling: build sentence embeddings using static pooling with MAX, MEAN, LAST, or ATTENTION strategies on encoded sequences
refactor_replace_padded_values: replace padded values in sequence tensors with a specified pad value using batch layout masks
